title: Step 3: Executive Validation
body: Preparing, running and following up the Executive Validation readout that confirms sponsorship, success criteria, value and the validation path
kicker: 6 lessons · knowledge check at the end of this page
list_label: By the end of this module you can:
list: Complete the executive validation pre-work checklist.
Secure sponsorship, success criteria and the validation path decision.
Send the recap and update opportunity records within 24 hours.
